services.title: Integrated Digital Lab
services.description: Creation of dailies, editing proxies, and on-set verification. Technical packages for VOD, broadcast, and distributors. Backup on RAID 5 and storage on LTO-7/8 tapes with integrity verification (MD5/xxHash).

services.title: Color Grading & HDR
services.description: 2 color grading suites with HDR and 4K monitors certified in Dolby Vision. 4K DCI projection room for cinematic mastering. Advanced correction in SDR/HDR, P3, Rec.2020, ACES and T-CAM workflows.

services.title: Mastering & Deliveries
services.description: Finishing Masters in HD, 2K, 4K, SDR, and HDR following broadcast and cinema standards. Platform Deliveries: Technical packages for VOD/Broadcast fully compliant with global specifications.

services.title: Sound Design & Mix
services.description: Carefully crafted audio for film, television, and commercials. From dialogue editing and sound design to final mix, focusing on clarity, balance, and emotional impact.

services.title: VFX & Compositing
services.description: Seamless integration of visual effects and storytelling. From concept and on-set supervision to compositing, ensuring cinematic quality in every frame.

services.title: Post-production Supervision
services.description: Planning and management of post-production workflows. We simplify communication, prevent budget overruns, and adapt our teams from features to commercials.

raul.name: Raúl Lavado Verdú
raul.bio:
Senior Colorist and co-founder of MISTERIO, Raúl Lavado Verdu has spent over 17 years shaping images across cinema, television, and advertising.

Working at the intersection of precision, intuition, and technology, he specializes in high-end Baselight and HDR workflows, crafting a distinctive visual language defined by texture, depth, and emotional clarity.

His work includes internationally recognized titles such as La Espera, La Última, Papeles, and Cuéntame, collaborating closely with leading directors and cinematographers.

In 2024, receive a FilmLight Colour Award for his work on La Espera, positioning him among the most respected voices in contemporary color grading.

Alongside his studio work, he is also a lecturer at ECAM, where he mentors the next generation of colorists.

fady.name: Fady Melek
fady.bio:
With over two decades of experience, Fady brings a rare combination of artistic sensitivity and scientific precision, shaped by his background in both art and chemistry. He began his career in film laboratories, later joining Technicolor, where he contributed to major international productions such as Taken and Transporter.
A recipient of four Telly Awards and the 2024 Global Recognition Award, Fady has built a reputation for excellence, consistency, and a deep understanding of image craftsmanship. Today, he leads the operations of Misterio Color Lab in Brazil, overseeing high-end post-production workflows with a focus on precision, innovation, and cinematic quality.

cem.name: Cem Ozkilicci
cem.bio:
Based in Oslo, Cem is a Canadian, Norwegian, and Turkish colorist. Working fluently across French, Norwegian, Turkish, and English, he collaborates with clients internationally, with experience spanning Europe and North America.

His career began during the final years of telecine, before moving into digital intermediate workflows, where a technical background in Flame shaped his approach to image making. This foundation continues to inform a style that blends precision with a strong sense of visual identity across commercials, long-form, and series work.

In 2023, he received the Spotlight award at the FilmLight Colour Awards 2023.

Cem’s work is defined by a close collaboration with filmmakers, focusing on developing a cohesive visual language that supports both narrative and tone. He is particularly drawn to projects where subtlety and control play a key role in shaping the final image.
